title: "Ephesians"

# Ephesians

::: {.book-summary}
## Book Summary Insight

Ephesians presents God's eternal plan to redeem and unite people through Jesus Christ. Believers are saved by grace, united as one body, and called to holy living.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 1

<div class="key-verse">Ephesians 1:7</div>

<div class="identifier">In whom we have redemption through His blood</div>

### Why This Verse

Redemption theme

### Chapter Insight

This chapter celebrates believers' spiritual blessings in Christ. The key verse emphasizes God's eternal plan of redemption and the believer's identity in Him.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 2

<div class="key-verse">Ephesians 2:8</div>

<div class="identifier">By grace are ye saved through faith</div>

### Why This Verse

One of the foundational salvation verses

### Chapter Insight

This chapter explains salvation by grace and the unity of believers. The key verse teaches that salvation is God's gift, received through faith rather than earned by works.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 3

<div class="key-verse">Ephesians 3:20</div>

<div class="identifier">Able to do exceeding abundantly above all that we ask or think</div>

### Why This Verse

Famous promise

### Chapter Insight

This chapter reveals God's mystery of including Gentiles in His family. The key verse highlights the immeasurable love of Christ that surpasses human understanding.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 4

<div class="key-verse">Ephesians 4:32</div>

<div class="identifier">Be ye kind one to another</div>

### Why This Verse

Christian character

### Chapter Insight

This chapter calls believers to unity and spiritual maturity. The key verse encourages living in a manner worthy of God's calling.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 5

<div class="key-verse">Ephesians 5:25</div>

<div class="identifier">Husbands, love your wives</div>

### Why This Verse

Marriage teaching

### Chapter Insight

This chapter teaches holy living, love, wisdom, and godly relationships. The key verse calls believers to imitate God and walk in love as Christ loved them.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 6

<div class="key-verse">Ephesians 6:11</div>

<div class="identifier">Put on the whole armor of God</div>

### Why This Verse

Spiritual warfare

### Chapter Insight

This chapter addresses family relationships, work, and spiritual warfare. The key verse instructs believers to put on the whole armor of God to stand firm against spiritual opposition.
:::
